examples.title: Compile an LMA Deployment with a Service and a ConfigMap

manifests.deployment_yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: lma-hospital-a
  namespace: dagents
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: lma-hospital-a
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: lma-hospital-a
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: main
        image: ghcr.io/example/dagents-lma:0.1.0
        ports:
        - name: http
          containerPort: 8010
        env:
        - name: LMA_SITE_ID
          value: "hospital-a"
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 250m
            memory: 256Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 1
            memory: 1Gi
manifests.service_yaml:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: lma-hospital-a
  namespace: dagents
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: lma-hospital-a
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 8010
    targetPort: 8010
manifests.config_map_yaml:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: lma-hospital-a-config
  namespace: dagents
data:
  site_id: "hospital-a"

examples.title: Compile a CronJob and a Job, with a generated plan id
examples.description: Without a plan_id the service makes one from the clock, so plan_id differs on every call.

manifests.deployment_yaml:
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: aggregate-rollup
  namespace: dagents-batch
spec:
  schedule: "*/30 * * * *"
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          restartPolicy: Never
          containers:
          - name: main
            image: ghcr.io/example/dagents-gma:0.1.0
            args:
            - "--run-mode"
            - "aggregate"
            resources:
              requests:
                cpu: 250m
                memory: 256Mi
              limits:
                cpu: 1
                memory: 1Gi
manifests.config_map_yaml:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: aggregate-rollup-config
  namespace: dagents-batch
data:
  component-kind: "CronJob"
  image: "ghcr.io/example/dagents-gma:0.1.0"
